title: Report financial results
goal: The period's financial results are drafted as a board update whose every figure names the record it came from and keeps last period's definition, the decisions the board itself must take are the asks, and it is marked sent only after the founder sent it.

steps.do: Read the board record for its seats, its reserved matters and its reporting cadence and read the last board update, and list what this period's report must contain, by when, and which reserved matter each item touches.

Take cash, monthly flows and runway from the money summary, the plan from the budget and the actuals from the spend register, and build the period's figures with the same definition as last period and the record each one came from.

Draft the update for the board audience: the one headline change, the figures, what went wrong or is at risk in the lowlights before the highlights, and as asks only the decisions the board itself must take, each with its options and your recommendation.
Raise the decision for the founder to approve and send the report, and set its status to sent only after the founder has sent it, with the date.
Name the open decision each figure that moved against plan bears on and add it there as evidence, and propose to the strategy lead what the next report should add or drop.

done_criteria.check: Does every figure in the board report name the record it came from and keep last period's definition, and is the report still a draft or approved by the founder?
